newsitem.title: USA: ABB to supply San Onofre 2 & 3 fuel through 2005.
newsitem.headline: ABB to supply San Onofre 2 & 3 fuel through 2005.

text.p: ABB Inc said Wednesday Southern California Edison Co has awarded a contract to provide nuclear fuel fabrication and related services to San Onofre Nuclear Generating Station Units 2 and 3 through 2005.
The agreement with the Edison International subsidiary is valued at more than $80 million, the ABB Group subsidiary said.
ABB Combustion Engineering Nuclear Operations has been the sole fuel provider for both 1,127 megawatt pressurized water reactors located in San Diego County, Calif.
Units 2 and 3 began commercial operation in 1983 and 1984, respectively. The plants were originally supplied by Combustion Engineering. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212-859-1610.))
